mating_design.name: TorporTag
mating_design.source: User-provided mating-design intent for breakout analysis and firmware bring-up notes.
notes: TMP119 power is supplied from STM32 PB0 through tmp119_pwr.
TMP119 SDA, SCL, and RDY/ALERT normally use STM32L432 internal pull-ups. The I2C clock is expected to be slow because these pulls are high impedance.
R3/R4/R5 are optional fallback 10 kOhm pull-ups to tmp119_pwr and are not default population parts.

host_pin_map.required_state: Pull-down or no-pull if known driven; high-Z input during reset/sleep is acceptable if nCS is held high.
host_pin_map.reason: Flash SO is normally tri-stated when AT25_nCS is high.

host_pin_map.required_state: Pull-down in reset/sleep/high-Z.
host_pin_map.reason: Keeps flash input quiet while the device is deselected.

host_pin_map.required_state: Supply a valid +3.3 V rail whenever AT25, ADXL362, or LEDs are in use.
host_pin_map.reason: Primary breakout supply rail.

host_pin_map.required_state: Pull-down if interrupt is active-high; pull-up if configured active-low/open-drain.
host_pin_map.reason: Wake source inactive state must be deliberate for sleep current and false wake prevention.

host_pin_map.connected_part: U3 TMP119 SDA, optional R5 to tmp119_pwr
host_pin_map.required_state: Internal pull-up only when tmp119_pwr is on; no-pull/high-Z when tmp119_pwr is off.
host_pin_map.reason: Default design uses STM32 internal pull-up; avoid back-powering TMP119 when its rail is off.

host_pin_map.connected_part: U3 TMP119 SCL, optional R4 to tmp119_pwr
host_pin_map.required_state: Internal pull-up only when tmp119_pwr is on; no-pull/high-Z when tmp119_pwr is off.
host_pin_map.reason: Weak internal pull-up means slow I2C timing; avoid back-powering TMP119 when its rail is off.

host_pin_map.connected_part: U3 TMP119 ALERT, optional R3 to tmp119_pwr
host_pin_map.required_state: Internal pull-up only when TMP119 is powered and alert is used; no-pull/high-Z when tmp119_pwr is off.
host_pin_map.reason: ALERT/RDY is open-drain style; avoid back-power paths.

host_pin_map.required_state: Pull-up during reset/sleep/high-Z unless an external pull-up is added.
host_pin_map.reason: Keeps accelerometer deselected.

host_pin_map.required_state: Pull-down or no-pull if ADXL362 is known driven in sleep.

host_pin_map.required_state: Pull-down in reset/sleep/high-Z.

host_pin_map.required_state: Push-pull high to power TMP119; drive low or hold pull-down/off in sleep.
host_pin_map.reason: This pin is the switched sensor rail and controls TMP119 back-power behavior.

population_options.condition: Populate only if STM32L432 internal pull-ups are insufficient for TMP119 SDA/SCL/RDY at the selected slow I2C clock.
population_options.notes: These optional resistors pull to the switched TMP119 rail, not the always-on +3.3V rail.
